blurb: High Terrain Helicopters operates a fleet of Bell and Airbus helicopters offering mountain biking runs, scenic tours from 15 to 60 minutes, weddings, heli-skiing support, and various commercial services such as fire suppression and environmental work. They have over 50 years of experience in mountainous British Columbia and maintain a strong safety record. Their helicopters are equipped for specialized tasks including human external transport and long-lining.
